note: Initial gate ledger per C-12 and 05-INTEGRATIONS-AND-RELEASE-GATES.md. All gates remain unapproved until primary vendor agreements, technical spike evidence, and explicit founder decisions are recorded.

gates.title: CloakBrowser OEM/Redistribution Rights, Free-Tier Eligibility & Isolation
gates.published_permission_state: Official CloakBrowser binary licence restricts third-party redistribution, bundling, embedding, and customer-facing browser control without a separate OEM/SaaS agreement; README and BINARY-LICENSE.md differ on latest-build free tier eligibility [12][13][14].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Wrapper docs describe a free GitHub-authenticated key with a 1-concurrent-session limit and profile flags, but isolated cache/licence/profile paths and extension loading in a bundled Mac product have not yet been verified via live spike.
required_evidence: Written vendor OEM/distribution/customer-browser-control agreement or verified compliant direct-download architecture approved by founder and legal review

P01 spike artifact (docs/evidence/browser-licensing.md) recording exact version, free GitHub key activation terms, 1-session concurrency time-multiplexing across profiles, and entitlement loss handling

Passing coexistence test (tests/coexistence/test_browser_paths.py) proving app-owned browser binary, profile, cache, and licence paths never read or overwrite an existing user CloakBrowser installation
dependent_features: GitHub-authenticated free browser entitlement activation during onboarding (O-03)
Time-multiplexed isolated browser profiles for auth, ATS, Teal, and LinkedIn
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Keep CloakBrowser provisioning gated behind vendor clearance; use an explicitly founder-approved isolated Chromium/Playwright test engine for local ATS fixture development only (never silently substituted as the customer browser).

gates.title: Paid-Product ChatGPT / Codex Commercial Integration & App Registration
gates.published_permission_state: OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT / token-sharing documentation distinguishes local open-source tools from paid/commercial products and requires commercial client registration/partner approval [3][4][5][6][7].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Codex OAuth / app-server protocol is documented, but commercial client ID registration and whether remote-session toggles are required for the approved commercial connector remain unverified.
required_evidence: Written OpenAI commercial client registration/approval for a paid desktop application (USD 20/month)
P02 spike verification of per-installation PKCE/loopback sign-in using customer's own account (never copied founder/developer client tokens)
Documented determination of whether Codex remote-session settings are required for the chosen connector, with user-performed security consent and return capability check (C-03)
dependent_features: ChatGPT subscription sign-in for primary Hermes browser orchestration (O-04)
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Show ChatGPT/Codex connector as honestly unavailable/gated in O-04 until commercial registration is granted; require explicit founder decision (D-02) if launching initially with OpenRouter-backed orchestration.

gates.title: Exact Model Capability & Dolphin Typed-Action Orchestration Adapter
gates.published_permission_state: OpenRouter public catalog (checked 2026-10-18) lists anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 (text+image+file->text, tools, structured_outputs) and cognitivecomputations/dolphin-mistral-24b-venice-edition (text->text only; no native tools/tool_choice advertised; no :free variant in snapshot) [11].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Catalog metadata only; no funded runtime inference or structured DOM action-proposal benchmark has been executed yet.
required_evidence: P02 contract tests (tests/contract/test_provider_capabilities.py) enforcing exact model IDs (cognitivecomputations/dolphin-mistral-24b-venice-edition and anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5) with zero silent :free or paid model substitution

Deterministic typed-action proposal adapter and schema/permission validator for Dolphin tested against controlled ATS DOM fixtures (malformed output, unauthorized actions, unknown fields, no-progress timeout, text-only observation limits)
Consented funded capability smoke check proving runtime completion and budget enforcement
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: If Dolphin fails deterministic typed-action fixture benchmarks or encounters vision-mandatory steps, mark Dolphin browser orchestration blocked and require explicit founder approval (D-03) before enabling any alternative orchestration model.

gates.title: Gmail Onboarding Flow: Automated App-Password Eligibility vs. Desktop OAuth
gates.published_permission_state: Google requires 2-Step Verification for App Passwords and disables them for Advanced Protection, certain Workspace policies, and specific security-key configurations; Google recommends OAuth 2.0 with PKCE for native desktop apps [19][20].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Unattended background creation/scraping of Google security pages violates security boundaries; trusted native secret capture vs. OAuth PKCE loopback must be spiked in P03/P04.
required_evidence: Founder decision (D-04) selecting OAuth-first with eligible guided app-password fallback vs. app-password-first

P03/P04 spike proving whether a permitted user-authenticated app-password flow can transfer the generated credential via a trusted native secret path (suppressing agent DOM, screenshots, traces, clipboard history, and extensions per C-04/C-07)
Acceptance test coverage (T-MAIL-02) for 2SV-disabled, Advanced Protection, and Workspace-managed account states
dependent_features: Long-lived Gmail authentication and credential storage in SOPS+age via CredentialBroker
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Recommend Desktop OAuth PKCE as primary default (subject to D-04 approval) alongside an eligibility-checked, user-consented App Password flow using native masked secret capture.

gates.title: Gmail Production Verification, Transport Blast Radius & Cloud LLM Data Boundary
gates.published_permission_state: Gmail API sensitive/restricted scopes require production OAuth client verification, Limited Use compliance, and security assessment where applicable, especially when transmitting Google user data to third-party cloud LLM processors [21].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Local deterministic header/thread correlation can operate without cloud LLMs, whereas sending email bodies/attachments to OpenRouter/Anthropic/OpenAI triggers third-party processor rules.
required_evidence: Explicit transport & scope specification (Gmail API least-privilege scopes vs. IMAP/SMTP blast radius) in docs/evidence/google.md

Enforced PolicyBroker default-deny gate blocking Google-derived data (bodies, summaries, embeddings, screenshots, attachments) from cloud models until processor/verification approval is recorded (C-05)
Verified production Google OAuth client registration and Limited Use compliance sign-off
dependent_features: Cloud LLM classification/summarization of recruiter emails
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Enforce strict default-deny on sending any Google-derived mail data to external LLMs; ship local deterministic thread/header/bounce reconciliation first while Google verification is pending.

gates.title: CapSolver Extension Redistribution, Compatibility & Ephemeral Runtime Key Delivery
gates.published_permission_state: CapSolver developer docs describe extension loading and API-key configuration via assets/config.js or runtime storage [15], but writing customer keys into plaintext on-disk extension files violates AA-AUTH-004 and C-07.
gates.technically_observed_capability: Extension packaging, redistribution permission, CloakBrowser compatibility, and ephemeral runtime key injection without persistent plaintext files have not yet been tested.
required_evidence: Verification of CapSolver extension redistribution/bundling rights and pinned version integrity
P04/P26 spike proving ephemeral runtime key delivery into the isolated ATS browser profile without rewriting distributed extension source files in plaintext
Enforcement of host/profile isolation (CapSolver excluded from trusted auth/Google/Teal/LinkedIn profiles per C-07) and human handoff on site access restrictions
dependent_features: Preinstalled/enabled CapSolver extension in owned ATS browser profile (O-06)
Automated permitted challenge assistance within customer budget
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Keep CapSolver disabled until ephemeral key injection and host-allowlist isolation pass T-SEC-03; always hand off security challenges to the user in takeover mode.

gates.title: Teal Job Tracker Approved Integration Route
gates.published_permission_state: Teal documentation and Terms of Service govern service access; no public partner write API was established in initial research, and a customer browser login does not grant commercial API/scraping licence [16][17].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Private endpoints observed in personal VB Jobs workflows are not a commercial contract and must not be hardcoded as an unapproved product API.
required_evidence: Documented vendor partnership/API approval or explicitly permitted customer-session integration recorded in docs/evidence/teal.md
Contract test (tests/contract/test_tracker_identity.py) verifying exact canonical URL/role/account matching, sibling record preservation, and post-write field readback (C-10)
dependent_features: Automated synchronization of verified applications to https://app.tealhq.com/job-tracker
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Maintain authoritative local SQLite ledger with durable outbox (sync_pending) and one-click CSV/JSON export while Teal partner/integration permission is pending (requires D-05 confirmation for launch).

gates.title: LinkedIn Automated Networking Platform Permission
gates.published_permission_state: LinkedIn official policy strictly prohibits unauthorized bots, scrapers, and extensions that automate website activity, including profile reading, connection-status polling, invitations, and messaging [18].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Browser session retention is technically possible, but any automated LinkedIn read, scrape, poll, connection request, message, or follow-up violates published platform terms unless executed via an approved partner program.
required_evidence: Written LinkedIn partner/API approval covering contact lookup, connection invitations, messaging, and status polling, OR

Explicit founder sign-off on D-06 to launch with automated LinkedIn reads/sends hard-blocked by PolicyBroker (T-SOC-01) and provide only local reviewed drafts, follow-up reminders, and genuine user-operated handoff
dependent_features: Automated LinkedIn profile/contact extraction and reply polling
Automated LinkedIn connection requests, initial messages, and follow-ups
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Hard-gate all automated LinkedIn reads/writes/polls in PolicyBroker; enable local draft generation, cadence reminders, and manual user-operated handoff with transparent UI labelling (subject to D-06 approval).

gates.title: macOS Developer ID Signing, Notarization, Helper Containment & TCC Identity
gates.published_permission_state: macOS direct distribution requires Developer ID signing, Hardened Runtime, and Apple notarization for the app bundle and all nested binaries/runtimes; TCC permissions bind to signed code identities and must be requested individually [22][23].
gates.technically_observed_capability: Local development builds can run ad-hoc signed, but clean-machine Gatekeeper acceptance, nested Python/Hermes/browser signing, Keychain ACL continuity across updates, and helper sandbox containment require real Developer ID credentials and clean-Mac verification.
required_evidence: Provisioned Apple Developer ID Application/Installer certificates and final reverse-DNS bundle identifier (D-09)
P03/P04/P07 containment & permission spike (docs/evidence/macos-permissions.md) documenting exact per-process filesystem/network/IPC/Keychain authority and adversarial bypass tests (C-06)
Clean-machine installation, notarization stapling, update rollback, and TCC permission grant/denial/revocation evidence (T-INS-01..06, T-PERM-01..03, T-REL-01)
dependent_features: One-go signed/notarized macOS installation without Gatekeeper workarounds
Keychain-backed age private key custody across app updates
gates.proposed_reduced_scope_option: Develop and test locally using development signing and explicit mock/local classification; block commercial distribution until Developer ID signing, notarization, and clean-Mac tests pass.
